components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept
            when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and
            brackets are stripped. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only control flag for create. When another owner already has
            the same lastName and address (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace), the create is normally rejected with 409;
            setting this to true acknowledges the shared household and allows
            the create to proceed. Never persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier for the owner's household, assigned on create
                and derived from the owner's lastName and address (compared
                case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). All owners sharing
                the same lastName and address — for example those joining an
                existing household via 'sharesHousehold' — receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F2C1B9D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName
                and lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this
                owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last
                two digits of the registrationDate year. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and
                an email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - SILVER
                - BRONZE
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I implemented `locality` as a derived, read-only field on the owner, computed from the city via the fixed table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD, else `UNKNOWN`).

Changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` schema (alongside the other derived fields like `displayName`/`membershipTier`), so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes `locality` in every owner response.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/LocalityLookup.java`** (new) — A small static utility holding the fixed city→region table and a `regionFor(city)` method returning the canonical region or `"UNKNOWN"`.

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a MapStruct `@Mapping` expression for `locality` that calls `LocalityLookup.regionFor(owner.getCity())`, consistent with how the other purely-derived read fields are mapped.

Deriving it in the mapper (rather than storing it) means it's correct for both the create response and subsequent `GET`s, matching the test flow.

### One notable gotcha I hit and fixed
My first attempt put the lookup as a `default String localityFor(String)` method on the `@Mapper` interface. MapStruct treats **any** single-arg method on a mapper as a candidate mapping method, so it silently applied `localityFor(...)` to *every* String property (firstName, address, city, etc.), corrupting all fields and causing 500s. Moving the helper into a separate non-mapper class resolved it — that's why `LocalityLookup` is deliberately kept outside the mapper interface (documented in its Javadoc).

I implemented `locality` as a derived, read-only field on the owner, computed from the city via the fixed table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD, else `UNKNOWN`).

Changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` schema (alongside the other derived fields like `displayName`/`membershipTier`), so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes `locality` in every owner response.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/LocalityLookup.java`** (new) — A small static utility holding the fixed city→region table and a `regionFor(city)` method returning the canonical region or `"UNKNOWN"`.

3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Added a MapStruct `@Mapping` expression for `locality` that calls `LocalityLookup.regionFor(owner.getCity())`, consistent with how the other purely-derived read fields are mapped.

Deriving it in the mapper (rather than storing it) means it's correct for both the create response and subsequent `GET`s, matching the test flow.

### One notable gotcha I hit and fixed
My first attempt put the lookup as a `default String localityFor(String)` method on the `@Mapper` interface. MapStruct treats **any** single-arg method on a mapper as a candidate mapping method, so it silently applied `localityFor(...)` to *every* String property (firstName, address, city, etc.), corrupting all fields and causing 500s. Moving the helper into a separate non-mapper class resolved it — that's why `LocalityLookup` is deliberately kept outside the mapper interface (documented in its Javadoc).
